reason: Existing exports already factor the principal shared work: N001 supplies measure/dimension and small-cover facts to R002/R004/R006/R007, N002 supplies boundedness/finite-content facts to R004/R005/R007, and N003 supplies interval enclosure to R005/R006. Duplicating these would add producer and review overhead without removing new work. The equal-interval subdivision calculation genuinely repeats in R004:S001 and R006:S001; geometric-error summation and epsilon removal also recur in R005:S003-S004 and R006:S002. However, inventory.json lists every inference R001-R007 under consumers_with_background_notes. The current narrow delta route cannot edit any of these consumers, so no extraction can replace derivations in two eligible consumers. Adding a producer alone would save no consumer work while requiring independent producer/cut reviews; broader local rereview is outside this bounded task. Retain the accepted NL0 unchanged; no speedup is inferred from fanout.
